text: Then it ended. The payment was confirmed, and he was released. No charges. No apology. He could have let it go. He sued instead.

He sued — not for the money, but on a principle: that a person arrested over a minor, unpaid fine should not be strip-searched when there is no reason at all to suspect he is hiding anything.

text: The Court held, five votes to four, that a jail may strip-search anyone entering general population. Whatever they were arrested for.
